addition.item: Ready-made Calm Aurora, Soft Gradient, Tech Grid, Quiet Dots, Ocean Waves and Playful Shapes presets; Custom keeps the existing controls.

change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

fix.item: Shape Dividers in a section with an animated background dropped into the content as white bands instead of sitting on the section's edges. Content that is positioned on purpose now keeps its position, and dividers always show above the animation.

addition.item: First release: an Animated Background panel for YOOtheme's Section, opened from its Settings tab, with five effects behind the content: Aurora (soft lights drifting slowly), Gradient Flow (colour bands flowing across the section), Waves (three layered waves along the bottom), Moving Pattern (a fine grid, dots or diagonal lines drifting slowly, fading out towards the edges, in any size) and Floating Shapes (circles, rounded squares, rings or triangles rising slowly; 8, 14 or 22 of them).
Grain: a fine, still grain texture over the section background, with any effect or on its own.

Colours: Auto (the theme's primary colour, and light glows on Primary and Secondary sections, held back so the section keeps its colour and its text stays readable), Corporate, Vibrant, or three custom colours.
Intensity (subtle, medium, strong) and speed (slow, medium, fast, still). The defaults are subtle and slow, so the effect suits business sites as it is.
Light on the browser: only transform and opacity are animated, animations pause while the section is off screen, and visitors who prefer reduced motion see a still picture.
